responsibility: This AWK generator emits the C implementation used to save, restore, hash, compare, stream, and free GCC optimization and target option state structures. From the merged .opt records it builds functions such as cl_optimization_save, hashing/equality routines, explicit-mask bookkeeping, serialization/deserialization for LTO or IPA uses, and consistency checks on locally modified global_options. It is the code generator for the operational support around cl_optimization and related option snapshots.
